commentary.text: 口径更新：增量资金已计入 ICI 美股共同基金净流出（每月 −$38~−115B），供需差水平比此前 ETF-only 口径低约 $40–115B/月，z6 方向基本不变。7月：供需差全年最弱（+$12B / 1.5bp，扣分红 −$45B / −5.9bp，z6 −1.4）。供给端有 SK hynix ADR（$26.5B）等，IPO 合计 $31.5B，6–7 月共 ~$116B；需求端融资余额 −$85B 去杠杆，基金净流入（ETF+共同基金）仅 +$12B。8月：融资余额回补 +$37B，但 ETF +$76B 被共同基金 −$86B 抵消，基金净流入 −$10B；供需差 +$128B / 17bp（扣分红 +$71B），z6 ≈ 0。内部人卖出升至 $18.9B，是年内高点。9月：ETF 流入降至 $38B，共同基金 −$80B，基金净流入 −$42B，为样本期最弱；增量资金转负（−$16B），供需差 +$99B / 13bp（扣分红 +$42B / 5.6bp），z6 −0.4。IPO 只有 6 家，首日破发率 75%、首日中位数 −6%，一级市场明显降温；同月美联储加息 25bp，10Y 5.27%。结论：美股净股权供给长期为负（回购+分红 ≈ $150B/月，大于发行），供需差为正主要靠回购和分红托底；ETF 流入大部分是从主动共同基金迁出，合并后的基金净流入接近零，边际变化更多由融资余额驱动。三季度基金资金逐月走弱，情绪指标领先走弱。留意 12 月：SpaceX（$75B，6/12 上市）锁定期到期，届时 lockup_ref 会出现尖峰。

美股共同基金（ICI 国内股票型，不含 ETF/FoF）每月净流出 −$38~−115B，已计入增量资金；ETF 流入很大一部分是从共同基金迁移过来的，两者需合并看
notes: ETF values (FactSet via First Trust ETF Data Watch: Asset Flows Monitor) parsed directly from each monthly PDF; each edition reports the prior month. etf_all_equity = 'Equity ETFs had net inflows totaling ...' bullet.

mf_domestic_equity = ICI Trends 'Domestic equity' net new cash flow ($M -> $B), first print from each month's own release where available (later releases revise by <$0.1B). Oct-2025 is from the Nov-2025 release (Oct column, -104.213; consistent with FY2025 -1,052.295 minus Jan-Sep -760.098 minus Nov/Dec). Jun-2026 is from the Jul-2026 release (Jun column). Sum Jan-Sep 2026 = -621.4B vs ICI Sep-2026 YTD -620.087B (difference = revisions).

ici.org/iciglobal.org return 403 to local curl and every trends_MM_YY URL redirects to the latest release in web_fetch; per-month releases were read from Wayback Machine snapshots (CDX: web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url=ici.org/research/stats/trends*), plus iciglobal.org pages surfaced by web_search. Do not use ICI 'Active and Index Investing' figures (they combine MF + ETF).

follow_on 2026Q1 = ICR follow-ons $35B + blocks $7B. follow_on 2026Q2 = ICR 1H 2026 '$92 billion raised across 163 follow-ons' minus Q1 $42B (assumes 1H figure includes blocks; if it excludes blocks, Q2 follow-ons ex-blocks would be ~$57B). Q2 includes Alphabet's record $44.75B follow-on. follow_on 2026Q3 = ICR 'approximately $50 billion across follow-ons and block trades'.
convertible 2026Q1 = ICR $31B; 2026Q2 derived = ICR 1H $90B minus Q1 $31B = $59B; 2026Q3 = ICR 'exceeding $40 billion' (lower bound).

2025Q4 follow_on/convertible: ICR has no Q4-2025 page (FY2025 page gives only IPOs: 73 raising ~$44B). Conflicting unverified search-summary candidates: follow-ons ~$33B across 111 deals (Houlihan Lokey FY2025 ECM update / CMG) vs ~$47.2B; US converts ~$33.6B (Matthews South 2025 year-end review) vs North America ~$36B (Numerix). FY2025 US converts ~$123-124B. ICR Q3 2025 converts $34B. Left null.
IPOs for context (ICR): Q1 2026 21 IPOs ~$10B; 1H 2026 69 IPOs ~$132B (incl. SpaceX $86B) => Q2 ~44 IPOs ~$122B; Q3 2026 20 IPOs ~$33B.

buyback/dividend: S&P DJI has not posted 2026 S&P 500 buyback releases on press.spglobal.com (latest is Q3 2025: buybacks $249.0B, dividends $168.1B; 12M to Sep-2025 buybacks $1.020T, dividends $664.9B). Q4 2025-Q3 2026 quarterly totals not found. Neuberger Berman (Sep 2026) cites S&P 500 buybacks of ~$1.10T for 12 months to June 2026 (not quarterly). S&P DJI Jan-2026 dividend release gives only per-share/indicated changes (US common indicated dividend increase +$13.1B in Q4 2025).
